errors.text_span: 纵轴为“置信区间宽度值”
errors.evidence: The vertical axis does not have a label. The description incorrectly uses part of the chart title, '置信区间宽度值对比' (Comparison of confidence interval width values), as the y-axis label.
The line connecting the data points is grey, not blue. Only the circular markers at each data point are blue.
The starting value at x=0 is visibly below the halfway point between 1.8 and 1.9, approximately at 1.84. The stated value of 1.85 is an overestimation.

The description claims the value is maintained between approximately 1.54 and 1.58 in the x=2 to x=28 range. However, the value drops below 1.54 starting from x=10, reaching approximately 1.50 at x=28.
The data point at x=28 has a value of exactly 1.50, not 1.45.
The description ends its analysis at x=28. It fails to mention the final data point on the graph, which occurs after x=28 and shows a further drop in value to approximately 1.42.
